integrity: Analytical proofs of spatial-temporal identity, iff Gaussian criterion and Pascal spatial almost-sure limit; finite verification tests are corroboration only; independent review not performed. The quenched special case may be derivable indirectly from known annealed estimates and is not offered in isolation as novelty.
scientific_limitations: Fair independent driving signs; fixed count-dependent signs; independent uniformly nondegenerate Bernoulli parameters for the random Pascal consequence; no sharp rate, no general stationary scenery theorem.
title: Spatial Cesàro classification and quenched Gaussian limits for Pascal-sign bootstrap walks
